records.title: misuse of pregabalin drug in Punjab
details: e to f: The DCC in its 65th meeting held on 20.12.2024 deliberated the matter related to misuse of Pregabalin and its preparation and its inclusion in Schedule H1 of Drugs Rules, 1945 to monitor the sale of drugs only on the prescription of the Registered Medical Practitioner (RMP).

records.title: EFFLUENT TREATMENT PLANTS IN AMRITSAR.
details: a to c: Under AMRUT 2.0 so far, 8 projects worth Rs. 213.29 crore have been approved by MoHUA in Amritsar district which include 7 water supply projects worth Rs. 102.89 crore and one sewerage/ septage management project worth Rs. 110.4 crore. Approved projects cover 25.99 MLD water treatment plant capacity and 30 MLD sewage treatment plant capacity.
